description: Only these fields may be removed before byte-for-byte comparison of native desktop artifacts. Any other difference fails C16-UX-01.

allowlisted_fields.reason: PE COFF TimeDateStamp is a container timestamp, not application code.
Optional PE checksum is recalculated after timestamp changes.
Windows Installer PackageCode is unique per package instance.
NSIS header timestamps are installer-container metadata.
IMAGE_DEBUG_DIRECTORY TimeDateStamp values are container timestamps, not application code. Hosted lanes A/B on c6c4787 differed by exactly three of these DWORDs.
CodeView RSDS GUID is a per-link debug identity, not application payload. Hosted lanes A/B on c6c4787 differed by exactly those 16 bytes.
